notes: A success kills 110 normals and eight elites. Summoned adds do not grant these rewards.
Boss and repeat-clear currency split the existing gold bundle; they are not two copies of it.
Regular first-clear currency is per hero. New milestone packages are once per account, with an explicit migration rule required.
Rarity is conditional on an equipment roll; awakening overlays rare/legendary, and sets are inside legendary rarity.
Choice gems are delivered in packs of ten of one selected color; 90 gems total. First-clear coins total 5600 and are not spent in the two-hour baseline.
First-clear box transactions, account claims and exact normal-clear eligibility are implemented. Other proposed drops, unlocks, material scaling and enemy balance remain unapplied.

notes: One free-to-play character, 1x speed, 120 foreground rift minutes; town time is additional.
180 days is a provisional design assumption. No user playtest or live-player telemetry is used.
Every stage consumes an explicit share of the fixed daily time budget; successful attempts include first clears and farming.
No payment, fatigue recovery, class-expansion validation gear, or unearned development grants.
Gems use the implemented 5:1 synthesis rule, not the stale 3:1 unlock text.

Successful full clears kill all 110 normal and 8 elite enemies and collect modeled drops. Chest collection 50%, goblin kill rate 80% of 10% spawns; 12 extra seconds per attempt. Failed-run rewards excluded.
Queue operation and shortened forge duration are proposed dependencies, not implemented behavior.
DPS is a normalized analytical benchmark with input skill/proc budgets, not measured combat DPS or a clear-rate result.
Reward quantities, salvage fractions, first-clear gifts and gem/rune schedules are owned by reward_parameters.json. Legacy schedule fields must match it.
R1-5 use 55 normals, 4 elites and about half the floor area. Unidentified purchases at R25 are optional and excluded from the reference loot projection.
